```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)

Song_level <- read_csv("Song_level.csv")
Note_level <- read_csv("Note_level.csv")


# Total number of songs and notes for each focal individuals

individual_summary <- full_join(
  Song_level %>% count(Individual_ID, name = "Total_Songs"),
  Note_level %>% count(Individual_ID, name = "Total_Notes"),
  by = "Individual_ID")
print(individual_summary)

```



```{r}
# Song-level PCA plot with 95% ellipses

feature_names <- c(
  "Minimum_F0", "Maximum_F0", "Delta_F0", "Mean_centre_F0",
  "Peak_F0", "Song_duration", "Note_count", "Note_pace")

# Prepare data
pca_data <- Song_level %>%
  dplyr::select(Sex, Individual_ID, dplyr::all_of(feature_names)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(feature_names), ~ !is.na(.x)))

# Run PCA
pca_res <- prcomp(pca_data[, feature_names], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
var_explained <- round(100 * summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)

# PCA scores
pca_scores <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  Individual_ID = factor(pca_data$Individual_ID),
  Sex = pca_data$Sex)

# Colours and legend labels
individual_colours <- c(
  "F1" = "#E6863B",
  "F2" = "#D99AB7",
  "M1" = "#3D9BCB",
  "M2" = "#3CB695")

individual_counts <- table(pca_scores$Individual_ID)

individual_labels <- c(
  "F1" = paste0("F1 (Female, N = ", individual_counts["F1"], ")"),
  "F2" = paste0("F2 (Female, N = ", individual_counts["F2"], ")"),
  "M1" = paste0("M1 (Male, N = ", individual_counts["M1"], ")"),
  "M2" = paste0("M2 (Male, N = ", individual_counts["M2"], ")"))

# Plot
Song_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Individual_ID, shape = Individual_ID)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Individual_ID), type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Individual", values = individual_colours, labels = individual_labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Individual", values = c("F1" = 15, "F2" = 15, "M1" = 16, "M2" = 16), labels = individual_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Song-level Acoustic Features",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "right" )

print(Song_pca)
```

```{r}
# Song-level Acoustic Parameters (violine plot)

# Prepare data
plot_data <- Song_level %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Individual_ID,
    Minimum_F0, Maximum_F0, Delta_F0, Mean_centre_F0,
    Peak_F0, Song_duration, Note_count, Note_pace ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

# Convert to long format
plot_data_long <- plot_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Individual_ID,
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value")

# Set figure sequence
plot_data_long$Feature <- factor(
  plot_data_long$Feature,
  levels = c(
    "Minimum_F0", "Maximum_F0", "Delta_F0", "Mean_centre_F0",
    "Peak_F0", "Song_duration", "Note_count", "Note_pace"))

# Individual colours
individual_colours <- c(
  "F1" = "#D55E00",
  "F2" = "#CC79A7",
  "M1" = "#0072B2",
  "M2" = "#009E73")

# Violin plots
Song_Violine_Plot <- ggplot(plot_data_long,
            aes(x = Individual_ID, y = Value, fill = Individual_ID)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Individual_ID), width = 0.12, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Feature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = individual_colours, name = "Individual") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = individual_colours, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Individual", y = "Acoustic measurements") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() )
print(Song_Violine_Plot)
```

```{r}
# 2.2 Method - Linear Mixed-Effects Model (LMM) Analysis


model1 <- lmer(Minimum_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model2 <- lmer(Maximum_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model3 <- lmer(Delta_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model4 <- lmer(Peak_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model5 <- lmer(Mean_centre_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model6 <- lmer(Song_duration ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model7 <- lmer(Note_count ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)
model8 <- lmer(Note_pace ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID), data = Song_level)

summary(model1)
summary(model2)
summary(model3)
summary(model4)
summary(model5)
summary(model6)
summary(model7)
summary(model8)


model21 <- lmer(Minimum_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID/Song_ID), data = Note_level)
model22 <- lmer(Maximum_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID/Song_ID), data = Note_level)
model23 <- lmer(Delta_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID/Song_ID), data = Note_level)
model24 <- lmer(Peak_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID/Song_ID), data = Note_level)
model25 <- lmer(Mean_centre_F0 ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID/Song_ID), data = Note_level)
model26 <- lmer(Note_duration ~ Sex + (1 | Individual_ID/Song_ID), data = Note_level)

summary(model21)
summary(model22)
summary(model23)
summary(model24)
summary(model25)
summary(model26)


# 95% Confidence intervals

get_CI <- function(model) {
  estimate <- fixef(model)["SexMale"]
  SE <- sqrt(vcov(model)["SexMale", "SexMale"])
  c( Lower_CI = estimate - 1.96 * SE,
    Upper_CI = estimate + 1.96 * SE)}

# Song-level 95% CI
get_CI(model1)
get_CI(model2)
get_CI(model3)
get_CI(model4)
get_CI(model5)
get_CI(model6)
get_CI(model7)
get_CI(model8)

# Note-level 95% CI
get_CI(model21)
get_CI(model22)
get_CI(model23)
get_CI(model24)
get_CI(model25)
get_CI(model26)
```
